from pathlib import Path
import datetime
root=Path.cwd()
backup=Path.home()/".local/state/gpu-unlock/backups"/datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
backup.mkdir(parents=True)
(root/"systems/dual-rtx3090/installation").mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
(root/"cache/dual-backup-path").write_text(str(backup)+"\n")
backup_code = """from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,shutil
root=Path("/home/vesanieminen/code/gpu-unlock-benchmarks")
backup=Path((root/"cache/dual-backup-path").read_text().strip())
images=sorted(Path("/boot/EFI/Linux").glob("*.efi"))
assert images, "No boot images to back up"
pairs=[(Path("/etc/default/limine"),backup/"etc-default-limine"),(Path("/boot/limine.conf"),backup/"boot-limine.conf"),(Path("/etc/mkinitcpio.conf"),backup/"mkinitcpio.conf")]
pairs += [(p,backup/p.name) for p in images]
pairs += [(p,backup/"mkinitcpio.conf.d"/p.name) for p in Path("/etc/mkinitcpio.conf.d").glob("*") if p.is_file()]
manifest=[]
for source,dest in pairs:
    assert source.is_file(), str(source)
    assert not dest.exists(), str(dest)
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(source,dest)
    digest=hashlib.file_digest(dest.open("rb"),"sha256").hexdigest()
    assert digest==hashlib.file_digest(source.open("rb"),"sha256").hexdigest()
    manifest.append({"source":str(source),"backup":str(dest),"sha256":digest})
report={"backup_directory":str(backup),"files":manifest}
(backup/"manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+"\\n")
(root/"systems/dual-rtx3090/installation/backup-manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+"\\n")
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
"""
(root/"cache/dual-backup.py").write_text(backup_code)
guard = """import json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("/home/vesanieminen/code/gpu-unlock-benchmarks")
runs=["baseline-gpu0-torch-20261025T170547.636586110Z","baseline-gpu1-torch-20261025T174345.952612565Z","baseline-vllm-20261025T174416.354859858Z"]
for name in runs:
    p=root/"systems/dual-rtx3090/results"/name
    assert json.loads((p/"status.json").read_text())["exit_code"]==0, name
    d=json.loads((p/"result.json").read_text())
    assert len(d["results"])==(4 if "vllm" in name else 3),name
    assert (p/"image.lock").read_bytes()==(root/"image.lock").read_bytes()
    assert (p/"model.lock.json").read_bytes()==(root/"model.lock.json").read_bytes()
    if "torch" in name:
        assert all(r["finite"] for r in d["results"])
print("All stock baseline guards passed")
"""
(root/"cache/dual-baseline-guard.py").write_text(guard)
script = """#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/vesanieminen/code/gpu-unlock-benchmarks
python3 cache/dual-baseline-guard.py
for run in systems/dual-rtx3090/results/baseline-*/; do
    sha256sum -c "$run/scripts.sha256"
done
sha256sum -c cache/dual-packages.sha256
python3 cache/dual-backup.py
pacman -U --noconfirm cache/gpu-unlock-src/packaging/arch/gpu-unlock-dkms-1.0.0-1-any.pkg.tar.zst cache/gpu-unlock-src/packaging/arch/gpu-unlock-firmware-1.0.0-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst
dkms status
modinfo -k "$(uname -r)" gpu_unlock
dkms status -m gpu-unlock -v 1.0.0 | rg ", $(uname -r), x86_64: installed"
python3 configure_limine.py --targets 0000:0b:00.0,0000:0c:00.0 --apply
limine-mkinitcpio
python3 verify_boot_images.py --baseline "$(cat cache/dual-backup-path)" --targets 0000:0b:00.0,0000:0c:00.0 --output systems/dual-rtx3090/installation/boot-images.json
pacman -Q gpu-unlock-dkms gpu-unlock-firmware
chown 1000:1000 systems/dual-rtx3090/installation/backup-manifest.json systems/dual-rtx3090/installation/boot-images.json
echo "Installation and boot-image validation complete; reboot not performed."
"""
(root/"cache/dual-install-root.sh").write_text(script)
(root/"cache/dual-packages.sha256").write_text("b59cbfd9166caa7731331934225e7e225bd3507c46ab8d51a2b976135dedac42  cache/gpu-unlock-src/packaging/arch/gpu-unlock-dkms-1.0.0-1-any.pkg.tar.zst\n99f5c909f46683043b6f496cb942ea81bdf40c388a4b1d1c4c837a84da7372fa  cache/gpu-unlock-src/packaging/arch/gpu-unlock-firmware-1.0.0-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst\n")
print("Prepared guarded installation, backup location:",backup)
